preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of queries for each test case is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The indices l and r are valid for the given string s, and the substring s[l:r] has an even length.

preconditions.expression: The sum of the lengths of all strings given in all test cases doesn't exceed 10^6.
preconditions.description: The total length of the input string s across all test cases is at most 10^6.

preconditions.expression: The sum of all q given in all test cases doesn't exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of queries across all test cases is at most 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The minimum cost to make the given substring a correct bracket sequence is non-negative.
